methodology: All 129 first-pass Pitrè 1900 OCR source detail IDs receive one of seven patronal complex research-level parents and exact backlinks to the existing 71 manually compared action-description pairs; 47 previously unpaired details are individually screened for role and historical/source limitation. These parent keys ARE NOT newly certified custom identities. Pitrè alone is one compiled historic text and does not prove 14 independent eyewitnesses. Original facsimile, primary historian witnesses, 1962 ritual authorization, and historical equivalence remain unverified. No action is promoted, no master owner assigned, no records double counted.
